confirmed_counterexamples: Active roadblock occupies deployment tiles; [9,2] deployment is invalid in the current model.
Merchant upkeep is real: 3 DP every 3 seconds, auto-retreat on insufficient DP, no confirmed refund.
Exact first merchant-upkeep debit remains UNKNOWN.
4-star and 5-star units from older plans are outside the current 1-3 star domain.
previous_plan_experience.prior_budget_note: The prior diagnostic exceeded a one-run budget; only the persisted final run is reusable as model evidence.

route_feedback_qualifications.COND_UPKEEP: Original Kimi condition asks whether upkeep is real/material; source confirms that condition. Saved status FALSE describes affordability failure, not absence of upkeep. Do not choose if_false base-ledger branch because of this mislabeled truth value.
route_feedback_qualifications.debug_roster_policy: NORMAL_MODE_ELIGIBLE_AND_RARITY_IN_1_2_3; old A1 units all4/5stars excluded; no automatic relaxation
route_feedback_qualifications.economic_counterexample: Any unoffset positive merchant debit before390 invalidates the old zero-slack 390 payment ledger if all its required deployments persist. Earlier automatic retreat changes the original responsibilities; numeric shortfall depends on tick phase.
route_feedback_qualifications.first_tick: UNKNOWN; runtime deploy+interval is an implementation assumption
route_feedback_qualifications.merchant_cost_interval: CONFIRMED_FROM_PINNED_GAMEDATA: 3DP per3seconds; no deployment-cost refund; insufficient DP auto-retreat description.
route_feedback_qualifications.normal_mode_policy: Exclude special-mode reserve operators, including 预备干员-特种 and 卫戍协议 variants; do not substitute 普通干员 such as 芬 with a name-based blanket ban.
route_feedback_qualifications.roadblock: Active trap_020_roadblock at9,2 rewrites deployment to unavailable; do not deploy caper there without evidence of release/destruction. Static legality test is not a combat trace.
route_feedback_qualifications.roster_scope: Existing source filters and both305-entry delivered pools exclude the13 reserve character IDs in pinned data. Future explicit selection must independently satisfy normal-mode eligibility; do not restrict tactical decision to old7 IDs.
route_feedback_qualifications.simulator_scope: Roadblock rule confirmed for rewriting roadblocks; patch currently rejects all active-device occupancy. No general proof for every device type. Changed runtime must be identified by actual commit/source hashes, not mechanics version label alone.

previous_plan_experience.tactical_thesis: Rebuilt opening on three corrections to A1. (1) The route-2 frame-0 rush is answered by the only unit that is simultaneously <=10 DP at f0, block-2, self-cheapened (runtime-supported), a DP engine, and durable enough to solo-hold and solo-kill: Fang at [4,3] facing LEFT — she arrests route-2 by f27 and grinds it out (~f627) with zero ranged support, freeing every other resource. (2) The [8,5] lane-01 anchor is rebuilt device-legally: instead of the roadblock-locked [9,2] caper, the block is Friston-3 (3 DP, block-3, DEF 235) on the ground tile itself by f191, and the fire is a crossfire from two legal high grounds — GALLUS² (3 DP arts, ~130 DPS vs RES 20) at [9,5] LEFT from f180 and Kroos (11 DP, ~390 effective DPS with her AUTO skill) at [7,5] RIGHT from f510 — timed so route-1 dies ~f590 and route-3 ~f718, bracketing the f431 double-block pressure spike that is Friston-3's only lethal window; Lancet-2 at [6,5] RIGHT (f570, runtime-supported +200 global burst) carries Friston-3 through it and leaves it standing at f941 to catch route-4's first arrival. (3) The lane-02 uterer triplet is handled as an explicit, budgeted concession set: route-6 (~f768) and route-8 (~f803, no legal interception tiles) are conceded because no interception+kill package is payable by those frames, while Yato at [5,1] (f630, by route-7's latest block 725) pushes route-7's leak to ~f946-1081. Economy is upkeep-free, refund-free, and slack-audited at every action; within-window life is 3 baseline, 1 in the certified worst case (fast enemy attack intervals collapsing Friston-3 before f718), 5 only if Fang also collapses — the plan's single named sensitivity. No unsupported mechanic is load-bearing; no feasibility is claimed.

source_wave_schedule.source_semantics: preDelay and interval are exact source offsets; the simulator applies its fixed hierarchical second-quantized policy.

terrain_navigation_facts.coordinate_convention: Route and device source row/col are field bottom-left coordinates; mapData.map is top-row-first and inverted for tile lookup.
limitations: Times are conditional unblocked model arrivals at 1 tile/second plus source waits; enemy speeds, client pre-roll and precise tick timing are not applied.
No cell or conditional model time is a deployment hard deadline; blocking radius, wait priority and dynamic roadblock navigation remain unverified.
The roadblock-as-full-obstacle variant is diagnostic only. GameData says roadblocks can block Ursa civilians and Talulah, but not that every WALK enemy treats them identically.
Do not infer no real interception from absence of a route cell centre; use continuous crossing evidence only as a static terrain consistency check.
